# Five Robot XApp SDK

SDK release 2026.10.19.2; API 2.15; package format 1. Freestanding C/C++ -> wasm32 -> .xapp; 240x240 ESP32-C3.

Start: https://site.flashbot5.com/developer/v1/index.json
GitHub: https://github.com/Yoriuml/five-robot-app-docs
Gitee: https://gitee.com/yorium/five-robot-app-docs
Pin the same tag on both mirrors. Verify sdk.zip SHA256 before extracting. Never reconstruct unreadable headers.

Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/ai-workflow.md, docs/quickstart.md, docs/development-rules.md, then real sdk/xapp/*.h.
api.json lists verified names, signatures, permissions and import version gates. Header comments define structures/ownership/units/quotas.
Run tools/doctor.py; tools/bootstrap.py installs checksum-pinned official tool archives. Generate with tools/create_app.py; build with tools/build.py; independently validate with tools/validate.py.
Test final callback exports and necessary imports, reachable exit and worst-case limits. Unused random is not required.
Headers unavailable: use complete ZIP, mirror, versioned file JSON or GitHub contents base64. If still unavailable, report the precise gap instead of inventing APIs.
No firmware/API/partition changes, credentials in source, WASI/malloc/threads or automatic flashing.
Static/host/runtime/hardware results must be separate. No device service simulator is bundled.
